title: 3Sum
statement: Return every distinct triple of values from nums that sums to zero. No triple may repeat, though a value can appear twice in a triple if it appears twice in the input. Order of triples, and of values within a triple, does not matter.
hints: Sort first. Sorting makes duplicates adjacent and enables two-pointer scanning.
Fix the first value, then the rest is Two Sum on a sorted array: a pointer from each end moving inward.
Skip over equal neighbours at every level, otherwise you emit the same triple repeatedly.
